data.title: Beach Mansions Frond C
data.about:
A new phase on Palm Jebel Ali by Nakheel Properties introduces luxury living through its meticulously designed villas and mansions. Beach Mansions Frond C consists of exclusive 5- to 6-bedroom properties, each with private entrances for enhanced privacy. This new phase on Palm Jebel Ali in Dubai showcases properties integrating luxury with functionality.

Residents will benefit from the addition of four shopping malls and 18 world-class hotels and resorts. The developer, Nakheel Properties, ensures future residents access a well-developed infrastructure that promotes a prestigious lifestyle. The new phase of the Palm Jebel Ali location offers seamless connectivity to major hubs, balancing city convenience with island tranquility.

Properties in this development promise unparalleled comfort and contemporary design, set amidst stunning waterfront views. The blend of exclusive living and modern amenities positions this phase as a prime investment opportunity in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Exclusive Beachfront Mansions at Palm Jebel Ali – Where Luxury Meets the Horizon
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Stunning Waterfront Location: Beach Mansions at Frond C Palm Jebel Ali by Nakheel Properties offers exclusive private beaches and breathtaking sea views.
  • Contemporary Design: Properties blend luxury with comfort through modern architecture and expansive 5 to 6-bedroom layouts.
  • Exceptional Amenities: Residents enjoy fine dining, shopping, and recreational facilities.
  • Prime Accessibility: Located just 30 minutes from Dubai Marina, ensuring seamless city access.
  • High-End Interiors: Designer finishes emphasize modern elegance and comfort

image.name: The Beach Collection at Palm Jebel Ali Dubai

location_tile.title: Private Beach Access, Lush Greenery, and Unmatched Connectivity to Dubai’s Finest
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Home to exclusive villas and mansions, Palm Jebel Ali provides a serene, family-friendly environment with lush landscaping, private beach access, and a variety of leisure facilities. Strategically located, it ensures seamless connectivity to Dubai’s key areas, making it a perfect retreat that balances tranquility and urban convenience.

  • 30 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 30 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 40 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 45 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
